mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 4.0% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 5.0% year-over-year triggers anticipated Fed tightening, suppressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 5.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days via reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: Joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns in >55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) signals accommodative Fed policy, supporting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days through stronger corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of instances when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth exceeding 2.5% year-over-year signals strong economic expansion, boosting corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >55% of instances when GDPC1 > 2.5, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 5.0) combined with elevated policy rates (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) creates a regime where prolonged tightening suppresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 5.0 and FEDFUNDS > 4.5, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly employment growth exceeding 200,000 jobs signals labor market tightness, prompting anticipated Fed policy tightening that suppresses equity valuations and generates negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >55% of instances when PAYEMS > 200000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 1-year windows.
